payload.core_mechanism_summary: Dynamic programming with a 2D state: dp[i][j] represents the minimum time to reach box j with i candies still needed. The DP transitions from states with higher remaining candies to lower ones by moving to a box l with different color and strictly more candies.
payload.rationale: The solution uses a two-dimensional array indexed by remaining candies needed (up to k) and the current box index (0 to n-1). The transitions consider moving to another box if its color differs and its candy count is greater, updating the time. This matches the dp_2d_state subtype exactly.
